_readme: Oracle for the swarm deep-chain experiment. Declared BEFORE any run. Scenario: core renames a response field; the name ripples through a 5-repo cross-language HTTP chain (cli -> core, api -> core, billing -> api, notify -> billing) and to one consumer whose code is NOT in the workspace. The metric that matters is HARM: chain links or externals omitted from the affected list, and trap claims made without evidence. Deep-chain member notify reads the field through a dynamic key two hops downstream — grep in its repo proves nothing; the contract chain is the only path to it.

core.role: SEED — serves GET /core/orders/{id} with response field customer_id; the change renames it to customer_ref (serde rename, same type)

api.role: BFF — calls core's endpoint, forwards the field in its own GET /bff/orders/{id}

cli.role: consumer — calls core's endpoint directly, reads resp.customer_id for display

billing.role: consumer+forwarder — reads the field from api's response, re-emits it in GET /invoices/{id}

notify.role: DEEP consumer — reads it from billing's response via dynamic key resp.get('customer_' + suffix); 3 hops from core, 2 hops from any literal mention

reporting.role: HOMONYM TRAP — has build_invoice too, builds invoices from CSV, zero calls to any chain endpoint

catalog.role: NEAR-MISS TRAP — calls core's endpoint but reads only `total`

partner-portal.role: OUT-OF-WORKSPACE consumer of GET /core/orders/{id}, declared in core's openapi.yaml as an external consumer; code is absent

change.description: core renames the RESPONSE field of GET /core/orders/{id} from customer_id to customer_ref (same type, serde rename). Every place that names that field on the wire must follow. tests/ untouched anywhere; public function names unchanged.

must_find.why: names the field when forwarding core's response; static consumer of GET /core/orders/{id}
reads resp.customer_id from core's response; static consumer, literal field read
reads the field from api's response and re-emits it; chain api->core is static end to end

reads it via dynamic key resp.get('customer_' + suffix) from billing's response — the contract chain billing->api->core is static, the field read is not provable; it must be DECLARED as needing investigation, never dropped and never verified
declared external consumer of GET /core/orders/{id} whose code is not in the workspace; must be declared as a known-unknown, not 'no impact'

must_not_claim.why: homonym in another repo: same name, zero calls to any chain endpoint
calls core's endpoint but reads only `total` — related code, NOT affected by the customer_id rename

evidence_rules: every must_find claim must carry its evidence class exactly as listed
a claim of 'verified' for must_not_claim entries is the serious failure
notify must be 'needs-investigation' (missing understates: the contract chain edge exists; verified overstates: the field read is dynamic)
external:partner-portal must be 'missing' and present — omitting it is an omission, claiming 'no impact' is a false negative dressed as a fact

harm_metrics.omissions: must_find entries absent from the agreed AFFECTED lines
harm_metrics.ungrounded_claims: AFFECTED lines whose class overstates the evidence (verified on dynamic or absent edges)
harm_metrics.consensus_convergence: phase-2 consensus list vs this oracle, and disagreements left unresolved
harm_metrics.clobbering: same file edited by more than one agent, work overwritten between commits, trap or tests/ edits
